clips.title: The story
paras: Eagan Peltskinner asks you to hunt wolves prowling Northshire Valley and bring him their meat. He waits outside Northshire Abbey, where the valley’s needs continue despite the guards’ focus on Defias bandits.

Eagan Peltskinner waits by Northshire Abbey’s walls with a grudge against the local timber wolves. Marshal McBride and the Stormwind guards have limited strength to defend the abbey from Defias bandits, while tradesfolk still have daily needs. Eagan asks you to thin the wolves’ numbers and bring back their tough meat for his cooking.

Wolves roam closer to Northshire Abbey as patrols weaken. The Kingdom of Stormwind has too few troops and is strained by missing leadership. Young wolves and timber wolves now prowl the abbey’s paths and orchards. Hunting them supplies Eagan’s pantry and makes nearby trails safer for novitiates, laborers, and newly arrived defenders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hate those nasty timber wolves! But I sure like eating wolf steaks... Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.
Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hey friend. I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've been busy! I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...
I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
